subject: [hw] DONE IP rev 1: 368 checks, expanded fault-path tests; IV ios-lib noted
body:
Rev 1 of DONE IP. Implementation unchanged in scope; two corrections and more tests.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IP PASS 368/368
    178/178 ASan+UBSan -O1 + 178/178 -O2 against the IV/V41 contract model, 12/12 against IVs real libn2vhost.a + the phone vendor set.
  bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh -> IOS BUILD OK (rwjpeg_tool 68432 B; vcodecd.o 25000, n2vcd_srv.o 2616, rwjpeg.o 11152, n2jpeg_hw_vt.o 14584 for arm64-apple-ios16.0; vcodecd still object-only here because the iPhoneOS SDK is absent - see below)
  bash gpu/hwcodec/install/stage.sh dev --partial --host-test -> STAGE HOST TEST OK

Since the first DONE:
- Added fault-path tests: ENC_SET -ETIMEDOUT tears the session down; ENC_SET -EPROTO is E_HW but leaves it alive; encode -EPROTO leaves it alive; encode -EIO tears it down; recovery OPEN works. V41s error semantics are now encoded (err_fatal only for -ETIMEDOUT/-EIO).
- ENC_FRAME.force_key -> VENC_SET_PARAM_FORCE_INTRA is now tested for the key flag and pts echo.
- Fixed a transport defect: an oversized SOCK_SEQPACKET datagram was silently truncated and parsed; recv now uses MSG_TRUNC and answers nothing, connection intact (tested with 1500 bytes).
- Session teardown now drops VENC and VENC_C1 power references; the fake hardware record proves POWER VENC on/off.
- HW timeout is also passed to n2ap_venc_open, so the AP IPI wait is bounded by --hw-timeout-ms.
- HELLO advertises 4096x2160 (the 4K VENC limit) instead of a guessed 3072 height.

Correction on the iOS blocker: IV now has make ios-lib and reports 33/33 objects + an arm64 archive when the real iPhoneOS SDK is present. That SDK is not installed here; build_ios.sh links vcodecd through N2VHOST_IOS_LIB as soon as the archive exists and otherwise prints the two commands. install/LAYOUT.md 6.1 and dsh-state/workers/IP/STATUS.md were updated.

Still the first phone blocker: client DMA PA (proposed RWVC_DMA_INFO on minor 0). P03 client/** is still absent. Full list in STATUS.md. Staying available for review findings.
